mo_ta_cong_viec:
We are looking for a passionate Software Engineer to join our product development team. You will participate in designing and developing software solutions for self-service systems such as Photo Booths, Kiosks, Automated Machines, and other Windows-based embedded solutions.
You will work closely with Business Analysts, Product Owners, QA Engineers, and Software Engineers throughout the entire software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis to product release.
 Responsibilities
Design, develop, maintain, and enhance software applications using Microsoft .NET technologies.
Participate in all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including:
Requirement analysis
System design
Implementation
Unit testing
Integration testing
Deployment and maintenance
Develop desktop and web applications using C#, .NET, ASP.NET, and Blazor.
Design clean, maintainable, and scalable software architectures.
Troubleshoot, debug, optimize, and improve existing applications.
Create and maintain technical documentation (design documents, UML diagrams, API specifications, etc.).
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software products.
Perform code reviews and proactively ensure software quality.
Research and evaluate new technologies that improve product quality and development efficiency.
Perform other duties assigned by the Team Leader.
